title: 8 arrested for alleged illegal fuel trading in Tarlac

blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — Operatives of the Central Luzon police’s intelligence division on Thursday arrested eight men allegedly involved in the illegal trade and transfer of million-peso worth of fuel in Victoria, Tarlac. In a statement on Friday, the Central Luzon police said two men were initially arrested in Barangay Santa Catalina for selling and distributing fuel products to motorists without the required government permit, clearances, and compliance certificate. “Petroleum products require proper handling and regulation because unauthorized activities can pose risks to consumers and nearby communities,” Said Brigadier General Jess Mendez, Central Luzon police director, in the statement.
